title: Mechanism-Fidelity for Computed Research Claims — a Worked Governed-Agent Example

citations.claim: The NIST AI Risk Management Framework organises trustworthy-AI practice into four core functions — Govern, Map, Measure, Manage — where Govern is the foundational, continuous function establishing accountability and oversight rather than a one-time control.
citations.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology

citations.claim: The NIST AI RMF Generative AI Profile (NIST-AI-600-1, July 2024) provides more than 200 suggested actions organised by RMF function for twelve generative-AI risk areas including Human-AI Configuration and Information Integrity, making governance substantially more operational than the base framework.
citations.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology

citations.claim: A KYE research-agent re-derived the runtime-authority decision latency budget (sub-50ms PDP decision at the action boundary) by simulation over the canonical decision-engine fixture; the claim was verified mechanism-faithful, not merely correct-looking.

regime_shift_check.condition_varied: decision-engine fixture swapped to the high-load tenant profile (10x request rate) — a one-step regime shift
